title: _PARADOX_

#  THE PARADOX
 
**In a dystopic future, the last beings alive work on a industrial complex, in the middle of a death ocean.**

 ![Mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9f94ded3eef8cecbcdb1403e523999630d9fd3a_0.webp)
 
 **Sometimes sending incursors to the past that bring destruction to your timeline in order to gather resources for their structure.**
 
  ![Incursor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25e90e081ffc5b82179c8717f9cf742821cb7f5f.png)
  
  **¡Go destroy their base to protect your timeline!  

 (using the drop of the incursor to travel to their timeline)
 **
  ![the paradox](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a11cefb5031a8f34bfe5bae34a49afd09a33992_0.webp)

## TIPS/WALKTROUGH

 -when arriving the future, you will be place at the top on the structure, on their surface level, wich is like a sea platform, defeat the enemies, gather loot and descend to the rest of the structure!

 -The oxidized doors need to be rigth clicked with "grease" to be opened
 
 -Electric weapons use energy, when crafted have 20 energy, can be  recharged rigth clicking on "rechargers" wich you can find in the strcuture, (is block with some buttoms and a green square).
 Also rigth clicking tih a battery on your main hand and the weapon  in the off-hand
 
 -Look out for a "punch clock" block, that appears at the side of some door or entrances, it saves your spawnpoint ( o when you enter the structure again (after dying/ or getting out using another "home caller") you wont have to walk all the zones you already crossed.
 
**-TO DEFEAT THE PARADOX YOU MUST DESTROY HIS TOWERS, OTHERWISE IT WILL BE CONSTANTLY REGENERATING HIS HEALTH. YOU CAN DO IT WITH WEAPONS OR GRENADES**
